root_cause: An unbounded retry loop in checkout-api's handler burns CPU on every request and starves the worker threads.
evidence: metric:cpu_percent rises to saturation when the fault starts
log: repeated 'possible unbounded loop detected in retry handler' from checkout-api
recommended_remediation: Restart the affected checkout-api instances to shed the stuck work, then patch the retry handler to cap attempts.
risk_rationale: Restarting a production service is an explicit high-risk action.
title: cpu runaway retry loop (live)
